title: 19th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/19/2/2025).

Preliminary debate on a resolution submitted by Hulhumalé South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed, seeking members' views on the heavy cost of electricity and water services borne by small and medium businesses operating in areas other than Malé.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the government-sponsored bill, submitted by Dhidhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed, to amend Law No. 8/2020 (Water and Sewerage Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to debate a resolution on high electricity and water costs for small businesses outside Malé and to continue debating the Water and Sewerage Act amendment bill.
